Hi Hannah / Laura / Marcus / Neha,

Quick intro and background on Jordan Park (UX Lead) — was prioritized by multiple product teams at Scout. Jordan is currently at a late-stage startup in SF and is targeting total comp around $205k (base preference $180k + 10% bonus + equity). He is flexible on start date but prefers late Feb.

Scout attached Jordan's latest resume (attached). He has a strong portfolio (design systems, cross-platform UX, and generative design workflows) and asked whether Redwood can consider a leveling of L4 / "Senior Product Designer / UX Lead" and whether we have flexibility on base above the posted range.

Let me know if you'd like to schedule a final debrief / alignment call.

- Confirm proposed level (L4 vs L3) and recommended title.
- Recommend base / variable / equity structure.
- If manager recommends above-band base (>= $180k), we will need a comp exception + sign-off from People.

Subject: Re: Candidate: Jordan Park — comp target and availability

Quick debrief notes from interviews (PM, Eng, Design leads):
- Strong cross-functional craft, shipped design system components with measurable adoption.
- Excellent leadership examples, stakeholder management, and mentorship.
- Slightly above expectations for L3; comfortably in L4 for product-facing role.

Recommendation: Hire at Level L4 — title: UX Lead (Product Design).
Comp recommendation (target total comp):
- Base: $180,000
- Target bonus: 10% (annual)
- Equity: 0.08% (4-year vesting)
- Total target comp: ~ $201,000

Manager note: Candidate has competing offer in the $200–210k TCo range. If we want to be competitive, I recommend allowing base up to $190k (bringing total target comp closer to $210k). This would technically be above our posted band for L4; requesting a comp exception for base up to $190k with the bonus/equity as above. Justification: critical hire for product team, high ramp potential, strong ref checks.

I'll join the call 1/8 to finalize.

-Marcus
